status: Met for the stated GEO-012 conversion-volume/default-tolerance criterion
scope: Geometry and conversion evidence for the 24 retained clean STEP corpus models. This is not a full import, integrity, source, transport, dose, or physical-qualification receipt.

requirement_target.criterion: Default chord deviation is selected to keep every per-cell faceted-volume relative error at or below 0.1%; the user/default tolerance is recorded.
requirement_target.input_tolerance_recording: faceting_tolerance_m is null in each design sidecar; every native report records was_default=true, initial default chord, selected chord and all attempts.

native_cli.reader_description: No faris-occt-worker was present adjacent to the preserved binary; automatic reader selected the configured CAD Python helper.

historical_original_tori7_failure.note: Preserved as the original corpus conversion result. The fresh adaptive conversion does not erase or replace this historical failure.

separate_gates.note: These checks are not prerequisites for the stated GEO-012 volume/default-tolerance criterion and are not claimed as passed.

sidecar_order_recovery: An initial port harness pass supplied dictionary-order fingerprints; check 3 rejected those controls before conversion. The eight port sidecars were rebuilt in STEP volume order. Attempt-01 inputs/reports/logs are preserved separately and are not counted as pass evidence.
